Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal: vendor portal stitch & term uplift coordination

Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, MedSys is moving forward with a 12→18 month term uplift and a capacity bump (~2.5x) for Q3 throughput. We want to make sure the procurement path is frictionless so your team can accept the amendment and kick off PO processing without delays.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can procurement provision portal access for our contracts team (procure@medsys.com is fine) so we can upload the SOW amendment and updated invoice template?
- Do you have a preferred SOW template or should we submit the redlined draft attached?
- Please confirm any internal approvers and the approximate turnaround for PO issuance once the portal submission is received.

I attached a lightweight vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx that maps the artifacts we typically need (SOC2, subprocessor list, SOW, invoice metadata). If you prefer, we can submit a short mutual-action-plan (MAP) that stages evidentiary uploads vs procurement paperwork.

Plan I propose:
1) We submit SOW amendment + MAP to the MedSys procurement portal (target: by Fri 2026-04-30).
2) MedSys confirms account approvers and target PO date (typical: 7–10 business days).
3) Redwood provides SOC2 snapshot + billing contact and escalates if the PO slips >10 business days.

Can you reply with the portal link / ticket number and the contact who will triage? Once I have that, Aditya will prepare a pre-filled SOW and invoice CSV for your upload.

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachment: vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 4KB)

Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 21:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor portal stitch & term uplift coordination

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear plan. Portal access: please use the MedSys Procurement Portal and reference ticket PL-392 when you upload. I copied our procurement inbox procure@medsys.com; they will create the formal ticket and route to approvers.

Notes:
- We have a standard SOW amendment template attached (PDF) — if you send a redline back I can pre-authorize legal to triage it.
- Typical PO timing for term amendments is 7–12 business days once the packet is complete; the biggest delays are missing invoice metadata or mismatched company tax IDs.
- Our procurement lead is Jason Lee (jason.lee@medsys.com). Please loop him on the portal submission if you need an expedited lane.

I'll upload a short PO timeline PDF to the ticket and mark Jason as approver. Looking forward to the MAP draft.

Best,
Caroline

--
Caroline Smith
Head of Vendor Ops | MedSys Health
caroline.smith@medsys.com

Sergio / Aditya —

Thanks for looping me in. A few internal housekeeping items:

- Use Jason Lee as the point for PO escalations (thanks, Caroline).
- When you prepare the MAP, include a short evidence lane that points to our SOC2 snapshot (we should attach the latest attestations rather than link only). Procurement portals often reject packets if evidence is only a link.
- Aditya: please generate the pre-filled invoice CSV and include Redwood tax info + remittance instructions. Export format: CSV with columns (InvoiceNumber, Amount, TaxID, RemitToEmail).

Sergio — can you draft a 1-page MAP that calls out deliverables and dates (we'll attach MAP_v1.pdf). I'll sign off and route to legal for a quick SOW redline review. If portal uploads are delayed, we'll escalate to Jason after 5 business days.

Laura

Caroline / Jason —

Thanks — attaching MAP_v1.pdf (one-pager) with proposed milestones and who owns each artifact:
- 2026-04-30: Redwood uploads redlined SOW + MAP to portal (Sergio / Aditya).
- 2026-05-05: MedSys confirms approvers and requests any missing metadata (Jason / Procurement).
- 2026-05-12: Target PO issuance (subject to approver cadence).

Action items for today:
- Aditya: please attach invoice CSV and SOC2 snapshot to the portal packet.
- Laura: I'll ping legal for a 48–72 hour redline once the SOW is uploaded.
- Caroline/Jason: please confirm if there's an expedited review button in the portal or a specific ticket tag we should set.

If we get the portal packet in by EOD Fri (our time), we should be on track for the target dates above. If anything slips, we escalate to Jason and request a priority lane.

Thanks all — I'll follow up Monday with a quick status note.

Best,
Sergio
